question: Which bank launched the ‘Global Women NRE & NRO Savings Account’ in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bank of Baroda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bank of Baroda** launched the 'Global Women NRE & NRO Savings Account' in March 2025 to cater specifically to the banking needs of non-resident Indian (NRI) women.
 
• The account offers **exclusive benefits** such as preferential interest rates on deposits and loans.
 
• It is designed to provide **financial support and empowerment** to women living abroad, ensuring hassle-free banking services.
 
• Features include personalized services, free remittance facilities, and easy account management for NRE (Non-Resident External) and NRO (Non-Resident Ordinary) account holders.
 
• This initiative aligns with Bank of Baroda's focus on promoting **gender-inclusive financial solutions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NRE Account:** An account that allows NRIs to deposit foreign earnings in India, which are fully repatriable and tax-free.
 
• **NRO Account:** Designed for NRIs to manage income earned in India, such as rent or dividends, with limited repatriability and subject to taxation.
 
• **Bank of Baroda:** One of India's leading public sector banks, known for offering innovative and customer-focused financial solutions globally.
 
• **Women-Centric Banking:** Banks increasingly focus on customized products and services for women to address unique financial needs and promote inclusivity.
 
• **Financial Empowerment:** Such accounts aim to empower women by providing them with tools for better financial management and access to resources.
